newsitem.title: CANADA: NBA BASKETBALLS-ROGERS RETURNS TO RAPTORS FOLLOWING DEATH OF HIS SISTER.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALLS-ROGERS RETURNS TO RAPTORS FOLLOWING DEATH OF HIS SISTER.

text.p: Toronto Raptors forward-centre Carlos Rogers is expected to return to the team on Tuesday, four days after the death of his sister.

Rogers left the Raptors the day before the death of Rene Rogers in Detroit with the intention of donating a kidney to his ailing sister. He was unable to do so, however, after she contracted an infection and her condition worsened, preventing any transplant.
Rogers is expected to be with the team for tonight's home game against the Portland Trail Blazers but is not likely to see action.

He will rejoin his family in Detroit for Saturday's funeral services, in the interim missing Wednesday's game in Philadelphia and Saturday's home contest with Phoenix. The Raptors host Boston on Monday.
The 25-year-old Rogers is in his third NBA season and second with the Raptors. He is averaging 10.5 points and 5.8 rebounds in 30 games.
